title: Transnational routes whose endpoint lands outside the row's countries
context: Two megaproject rows, both CANCELLED or in-development and both already researched in the annual/cancelled-review packets — so do NOT re-research their status, ownership or cost. In both cases the likely answer is that the drawn geometry covers a different extent than GEM's start/end columns claim — decide which is wrong and recommend the fix as a validity finding.
